additional_info.subject: RE: ID0396757-DC/Si-D/CZ-[Y2/S6 313724839002]- Authentication issue CRM:00645000907
additional_info.body:
Dear Milan,
I hope all is well with you. As we discussed, we found the suspected root cause for the issue. the property DisplayTariffInformation in the OCPP backend was set to "user" and so the charger waits for a DataTransfer SetUserPrice which was not send. Request your support to coordinate with CPO to make the changes same as the charger - kZY8R2.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sambath.K.S

additional_info.subject: Status Update : 27.02.2025
additional_info.body:
Received feedback from R&D regarding the suspected root cause
Suspected root cause :
the property DisplayTariffInformation in the OCPP backend was set to "user" and so the charger waits for a DataTransfer SetUserPrice which was not send. So no /secc/actions/start_charging was sent.
Action Plan: Awaiting for CPO to make necessary changes from the backend & test charging trials
